answer: Sybil resistance by mutual insurance. Every identity writes thread policies for peers it has verified - but premiums are pooled per funding cluster, so a farm of clones holds one shared tide reserve. One proven fraud anywhere in the cluster drains that reserve to pay the harmed party, and honest strangers' premiums fall while the farm's rates climb. Verify before you underwrite: each policy lists the checks performed, so a willow of rubber-stamp policies marks the issuer, not the insured, as the risk.
